overview: Explain how a gene panel connects to disease biology, make specificity limits explicit, and state what evidence is still missing.
grounding_requirements: Every substantive report section after Disease Context Summary must include a visible `Sources:` line immediately after the supported content.
Disease-context claims must be tied to named evidence streams such as gene-set investigation, disease association tools, expression context, trait evidence, or retrieved literature.
When a section contains interpretation about specificity limits, missing evidence, or follow-up checks beyond direct retrieval, label it explicitly as interpretation, caveat, or next-step guidance.
Prefer human-readable provider names, paper titles, and direct links in `Sources:` lines. Keep artifact ids and tool names secondary.
Include the major disease-context evidence artifacts in `linked_artifact_ids` when saving the report.

section_grounding_expectations.heading: Question and Disease Scope
section_grounding_expectations.evidence_expectation: Frame the disease question and scope from the task context and the most relevant retrieved disease framing evidence when available.
section_grounding_expectations.interpretation_expectation: Keep this section descriptive and conservative.

section_grounding_expectations.heading: Dominant Disease Themes
section_grounding_expectations.evidence_expectation: Summarize the main disease or condition themes using the strongest disease-relevant evidence retrieved in-session.
section_grounding_expectations.provenance_expectation: Add a visible `Sources:` line naming the core evidence streams supporting the summary.

section_grounding_expectations.heading: Supporting Molecular Findings
section_grounding_expectations.evidence_expectation: Explain how the panel connects to disease biology using retrieved pathway, disease, expression, or trait evidence rather than pattern matching alone.
section_grounding_expectations.provenance_expectation: Add a visible `Sources:` line with human-readable providers, paper links, or artifact links that support the biological connection.

section_grounding_expectations.heading: Condition-Level Evidence
section_grounding_expectations.evidence_expectation: Differentiate broad disease programs from more specific named conditions using retrieved condition-level evidence rather than unsupported specificity claims.
section_grounding_expectations.provenance_expectation: Add a visible `Sources:` line that makes clear which evidence streams support the condition-level interpretation.

section_grounding_expectations.heading: Competing or Secondary Disease Interpretations
section_grounding_expectations.evidence_expectation: Use retrieved evidence to justify why competing disease themes remain plausible or weaker.
section_grounding_expectations.provenance_expectation: Add a visible `Sources:` line when alternatives are grounded in specific evidence streams.
section_grounding_expectations.interpretation_expectation: Label this section clearly as competing or secondary interpretations when it goes beyond direct retrieval.

section_grounding_expectations.heading: Clinical and Biological Boundaries
section_grounding_expectations.evidence_expectation: Tie specificity limits, confounders, or actionability boundaries to retrieved evidence when possible.
section_grounding_expectations.provenance_expectation: Add a visible `Sources:` line when caveats are supported by retrieved evidence.
section_grounding_expectations.interpretation_expectation: If a caution is general domain knowledge rather than directly retrieved support, keep it clearly labeled as a caveat.

section_grounding_expectations.heading: Next Disease-Focused Checks
section_grounding_expectations.evidence_expectation: Recommend next checks that are motivated by the specific evidence gaps or ambiguities found in-session.
section_grounding_expectations.provenance_expectation: If a next check is motivated by retrieved evidence, add a `Sources:` line; otherwise keep it clearly framed as next-step guidance.
section_grounding_expectations.interpretation_expectation: Label this section as next checks or recommended follow-up rather than as a retrieved fact block.

workflow_steps.instructions: Load the report templates and the disease-context template before evidence gathering.
workflow_steps.title: Load Template

workflow_steps.instructions: Start with a set-level investigation. Use targeted disease or trait follow-up only when it sharpens the disease-context interpretation or highlights important caveats. Carry the evidence forward into section-local `Sources:` lines in the saved report.
workflow_steps.title: Gather Disease Evidence

workflow_steps.instructions: Draft the report using the disease-context template, save it, and revise only if needed for clarity or grounding. Every substantive section should expose visible provenance and major evidence artifacts should be linked in the saved report metadata.
workflow_steps.title: Save Report
